summary.zh-CN: 以受控方法、认证、超时和响应上限调用一次 REST API。
summary.en: Call one REST API with controlled method, authentication, timeout and response bounds.

details.zh-CN: 支持 GET、POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE、Query、Header、JSON 或文本 Body，以及 JSON 或文本响应。重定向默认保持同协议同主机。
details.en: Supports GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, query, headers, JSON or text body, and JSON or text responses. Redirects remain same-scheme and same-host by default.

input_summary.zh-CN: URL、方法、Query、Header、Body、允许状态码和响应格式。
input_summary.en: URL, method, query, headers, body, allowed statuses and response format.

output_summary.zh-CN: 有界响应状态、内容类型、解析内容、字节数和 partial 状态。
output_summary.en: Bounded response status, content type, parsed content, byte count and partial state.

risk.zh-CN: 写方法可能产生副作用；非幂等请求默认不自动重试。
risk.en: Write methods can cause side effects; non-idempotent requests are not retried by default.

install_notes.zh-CN: 无需额外依赖；此 Variant 仅使用对应 Runtime 的标准库。复制后仍需选择兼容 Worker，并通过 Credential Binding 配置真实凭据。
install_notes.en: No extra dependency is required; this Variant uses only its Runtime standard library. After copying, select a compatible Worker and configure real credentials through Credential Binding.

query_auth.description: Optional API key query injection resolved from Credential Binding; credential-like names and secret values never belong directly in url or query.

input_contract.warning: POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE may have side effects and are never automatically retried or followed across redirects; credential-like direct query/header names are rejected and credentials are excluded from output

output_contract.response_byte_budget: applied to the normalized, scrubbed response before it is returned
output_contract.error: stable category only; configured credentials and raw transport exceptions are never returned

runtime_guidance.zh-CN: 模板复制后默认停止。为 python 选择兼容 Worker；Secret 键仅通过 Credential Binding 提供：HTTP_BASIC_CREDENTIAL、HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN、HTTP_API_KEY。凭据类 URL/query/header 名称默认拒绝；Query API Key 只能通过 query_auth.secret_binding 注入，Header 凭据只能通过 DLR-Auth 注入。脱敏标记不会比原 Secret 占用更多 UTF-8 字节，且返回前会对规范化、脱敏后的 response 再执行 max_response_bytes 检查。写方法默认不重试并拒绝重定向。
runtime_guidance.en: The copied template is stopped by default. Select a compatible python Worker. Secret keys are supplied only through Credential Binding: HTTP_BASIC_CREDENTIAL, HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN and HTTP_API_KEY. Credential-like URL, query and header names are rejected by default; query API keys must use query_auth.secret_binding and header credentials must use DLR-Auth. Scrub markers never use more UTF-8 bytes than the original secret, and the normalized scrubbed response is checked against max_response_bytes before return. Write methods are not retried and reject redirects.
